body:
If you’re a parent managing the dental health of a family that includes a pregnant mother, a cavity-free toddler, a 10-year-old prone to cavities, a teenager with braces, and a partner with less-than-ideal oral hygiene, would you choose the same toothpaste for everyone? What about other dental care products? Until now, finding individualized oral care that considers each person’s age, dental stage, risk factors, and personal preferences seemed impossible. But that’s all changed: introducing SuperMouth!

SuperMouth’s Age-Based Oral Care: A Tailored Approach for Every Life Stage

Understanding that oral health evolves with age, SuperMouth has pioneered a customizable approach to oral care, catering to the unique risks and needs of each life stage. We provide a comprehensive array of products and accessories to ensure the oral health of every family member is supported throughout their lives. 

Why Custom Systems for Each Age Group?

SuperMouth’s systems are designed to address the unique challenges and transitions of oral development:

  1. Pregnancy (Formative): Oral health in pregnancy impacts the health of the mother and the baby’s developing mouth.
  2. Teething - 24 months (Foundation): Teething and the establishment of the oral microbiome are critical at this stage.
  3. 2-5 years (Development): This period is pivotal for the growth of both the mouth and teeth.
  4. 6-12 years (Transition): Transitioning from baby teeth to permanent teeth often requires specific care.
  5. Teens & Adults (Maturation & Maintenance): Focus on protection and maintaining adult oral health.
  6. Orthodontics (Intervention): An increased risk of cavities and enamel decalcification due to the challenges in maintaining oral hygiene around braces and other appliances.

SuperMouth’s Systems: Customized for Comprehensive Care

To cater to these developmental stages, SuperMouth offers:

  • Toothbrushes: Custom-designed for each age and stage, our toothbrushes feature revolutionary bristles and ergonomic designs for safe and effective cleaning. They also include fun features such as music and augmented reality to foster positive associations with oral care.
  • Toothpastes: Our pastes are enriched with Hydroxamin (nano-hydroxyapatite, vitamin D3, and vitamin K2) along with prebiotics and other essential ingredients - available both with and without fluoride.
  • Flosses: Our flosses are infused with Hydroxamin and other key ingredients, and are free from PTFE (such as Teflon) and petroleum-based waxes, including microcrystalline.
  • Mouthwashes: Free from artificial colors, flavors, or preservatives and enriched with Hydroxamin, prebiotics, and other essential ingredients – available with and without fluoride. 
  • Mouth-sprays: Handy post-meal solution for maintaining pH balance and microbiome health.
  • Tongue Scrapers: Multiple designs for various ages, they remove bacteria from the tongue to prevent bad breath.
  • Accessories: Innovative tools like toothpaste dispensers, mouthcare organizers, and teethers to enhance and simplify oral care routines.

Packages Tailored to Diverse Needs:

  • Basic: Covers essentials: toothbrush, toothpaste, and floss.
  • Plus: Adds mouth spray and tongue scraper for a more thorough regimen.
  • Complete: The all-inclusive package with mouthwash for complete care.
  • Accessories: From dispensers to organizers, we provide all the additional tools families may need.

Personalized Oral Care for Every Stage of Life

SuperMouth’s systems are designed to evolve with your family, ensuring that from infancy to adulthood, everyone’s oral care is optimal, enjoyable, and stress-free. To further enhance your experience, you can take our oral care assessment for personalized recommendations by dental experts for every family member.
